task: Draft a one-paragraph glossary entry explaining the term 'incidence rate' for a fictional public-health education module. Distinguish it from 'prevalence' using a neutral example. No study data, no specific diseases, no clinical advice.

facts.text: The glossary is for a fictional public-health training exercise called the Meridian Health Literacy Module.
Incidence rate is defined in the module as the number of new cases in a defined population over a specified time period.
Prevalence refers to the proportion of a population that has a condition at a given point in time.
The module includes a comparison table distinguishing incidence from prevalence.

forbidden_additions: A specific disease name or numerical incidence rate.
A clinical recommendation or treatment reference.
A formula or equation not supplied in the module.
preserve: The distinction between new cases over a time period and existing cases at a point in time.
The educational, nonclinical scope of the glossary entry.
